nodes.name: Called by a workflow or agent

parameters.content:
## Try GifSnap
1. Open **Example search** and set a short `query` plus `limit` (1–10).
2. Select **Execute workflow**.
3. Inspect **Return GIFs**. Use `data[].url` for animation; previews may be still images.

No API key currently needed. One read-only search; nothing is posted or downloaded.

## Reuse in an automation or AI agent
Save this workflow. From **Execute Sub-workflow** or **Call n8n Workflow Tool**, select it and map only `query` and `limit`. Publish the sub-workflow before production calls.

Use a short, non-sensitive search phrase, not chat history. This example returns choices, not a posted message. Errors stop the workflow; empty results stay empty.

Setup and tested version: github.com/rowixgroup/gifsnap-sdk/tree/main/examples/n8n
